# Kaze **一个安静、快速的浏览器，支持 macOS 和 Windows，内置一个在你的标签页里干活的 agent。** [English](README.md) · **简体中文**

Kaze 是一个可以天天用的浏览器，里面内置了 agent。你提一个要求，它就在你的标签页旁边、用它自己的 标签页去做：每一步都给你看，你随时可以接手，付款、发送、删除之前一定先问你。这些带着你登录状态的 标签页，你已经在用的 agent（比如 Claude Code、Codex）也能用。 现在让 AI 用浏览器，往往要做取舍：用浏览器插件，它干活时会占住你的浏览器；用内置或云端的浏览器， 哪个网站都没登录；用 AI 浏览器，又常常不适合天天用。Kaze 想两头都做好：对你是一个真正的浏览器， 对 agent 是一个不会挡你路的工作区。 ## 快速上手 **1. 安装。** 在 [Releases](https://github.com/jackwener/Kaze/releases/latest) 下载： - **Mac**：Apple 芯片用 `Kaze-<版本>-arm64.dmg`，Intel 用 `Kaze-<版本>.dmg`，把 Kaze 拖进“应用程序”。支持 macOS 13 及以上。 - **Windows**：`Kaze-<版本>-win-x64.exe`，ARM 电脑用 `-win-arm64.exe`；只为当前用户安装，不需要管理员权限。支持 Windows 10 和 11。安装包暂未签名，第一次运行时 SmartScreen 会拦一下：点“更多信息 › 仍要运行”。 免费，不用注册账号，会自动更新。 **2. 搬过来。** 第一次打开时，Kaze 会问你要不要从 Chrome、Arc、Edge、Brave 或 Safari 搬来标签页、 登录信息、书签、历史记录和扩展。选“要”，你登录过的网站在 Kaze 里照样是登录状态，agent 也一样。 **3. 选模型。** 用 ChatGPT 登录、填自己的 API key，或者接任何兼容 OpenAI 的接口（设置 › Agent）。 **4. 提要求。** 按 ⌘E 打开 agent，试试： ``` 帮我找周五从伦敦到里斯本、120 欧以内的机票 ``` 它会把需要的网页放进一个以任务命名的标签组里，你照常浏览。按 ⌘. 可以接手；做完后一键关掉它开的 标签页。 **5. 让你的其他 agent 也用上。** Kaze 会找到你 Mac 上的 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、 Claude Desktop、Gemini CLI 和 DeepSeek Harness，通过它的 MCP 服务一次接好。比如在 Claude Code 里： ``` 读一下我在 Kaze 里开着的航班，把最便宜的加进 plan.md ``` 在“设置 › 外部 Agent”里可以断开任何一个，断开后不会再自动连上。 ## 自定义 Agent 接口 Kaze 内置的 Agent 可以使用自定义的 OpenAI 兼容接口。打开“设置 › Agent › 添加自定义端点…”即可配置。 以本地 Magpie 这类网关为例： 1. 启动网关，确认它支持 OpenAI Chat Completions 的流式输出和工具调用（function calling）。Kaze 请求 `{base}/chat/completions`，不使用 Responses API。 2. 填写**名称**和网关的 OpenAI 兼容基础地址（**Base URL**）。如果服务在 3425 端口提供 `/v1/...`，填写 `http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1`。 3. 网关不要求密钥时，**API 密钥**留空；否则填入对应密钥。 4. **模型**留空时，Kaze 会从 `{base}/models` 自动获取聊天模型，也可以手动填写模型 ID。 5. 选择支持工具调用的模型，再发送一个简单的浏览器任务。 要让外部 Agent 操作 Kaze 里已登录的标签页，打开“设置 › 外部 Agent”。支持的客户端可一键**连接**，其他 MCP 客户端可复制 **MCP 配置**进行配置。Magpie 提供模型服务；使用 Magpie 的 Agent 通过这条外部 Agent 路径连接 Kaze。 ## 亮点 | | | |---|---| | **用它自己的标签页，不动你的** | agent 在后台标签页里干活，放在以任务命名的标签组里，你的标签页原样不动。每个标签都显示状态：在做、需要你、做完了、你在操作。 | | **动手之前先问** | 付款、发送、删除或运行任何东西之前，都会弹出卡片写明具体要做什么，你同意了才做。 | | **你的模型，你的 Mac** | 用你选的模型。活动、历史记录和设置都留在你的 Mac 上。 | | **会记住网站怎么用** | agent 在某个网站上摸索出来的东西，会存成这个网站的技能，下次自动带上。在“技能”页里可以查看、修改、删除。 | | **同时做几件事** | 子 agent 把大任务拆开并行做；定时任务可以每天早上 8 点或周五跑一次；“活动”记得你读过什么，问“上周那篇电车的文章”就能找到。 | | **首先是个好浏览器** | 会自己整理的标签页、闲置标签自动休眠、⌘K 面板、⌥E 双语对照翻译、内置广告拦截、Chrome 扩展、每个窗口一种颜色，英文和简体中文。 | ## 这个仓库里有什么 | | | |---|---| | [Releases](https://github.com/jackwener/Kaze/releases) | Kaze 的安装包和更新说明 | | [`skills/`](skills) | Kaze 自带的技能，Agent Skills 格式 | | [`Website/`](Website) | 主页 [kaze.build](https://kaze.build)（纯静态文件，用 `npx wrangler deploy` 发布） | Kaze 的浏览器能力来自 [BrowserMCP](https://github.com/jackwener/BrowserMCP)（Apache-2.0）：一个开源 的 MCP 服务，用来操作已登录的浏览器，带 JavaScript 工作区和可复用的网站适配器。Kaze 借给其他 agent 用的就是它，它也可以单独配合 Chrome 使用。 ## 反馈 问题和建议请提到 [Issues](https://github.com/jackwener/Kaze/issues)，附上 Kaze 的版本 （Kaze › 关于 Kaze）和你的 Mac 是什么芯片。

# Kaze **A calm, quick browser for macOS and Windows, with an agent that works in your tabs.** **English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Kaze is a browser you use every day that has an agent built in. Ask it for something and it works in tabs of its own, next to yours: it shows each step, lets you take over at any moment, and asks before it pays, sends or deletes anything. The same tabs, with your logins, are open to the agents you already use, such as Claude Code and Codex. Most AI browsing today means a choice. An extension drives your browser and takes it away from you while it works. A built-in or cloud browser leaves you signed out of everything. An AI browser often doesn't make a good everyday browser. Kaze is built to be both: a real browser for you, and a workspace for agents that never gets in your way. ## Quick start **1. Install.** From [Releases](https://github.com/jackwener/Kaze/releases/latest): - **Mac:** `Kaze--arm64.dmg` for Apple silicon or `Kaze-.dmg` for Intel; drag Kaze to Applications. macOS 13 or later. - **Windows:** `Kaze--win-x64.exe`, or `-win-arm64.exe` on an ARM PC; it installs for you alone, no administrator needed. Windows 10 or 11. The installer isn't signed yet, so SmartScreen asks once: More info › Run anyway. It's free, needs no account and updates itself. **2. Bring your things.** On first launch Kaze offers to bring in your tabs, logins, bookmarks, history and extensions from Chrome, Arc, Edge, Brave or Safari. Say yes and every site you're signed in to works in Kaze, and so does the agent. **3. Pick a model.** Sign in with ChatGPT, add your own API key, or point Kaze at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Settings › Agent). **4. Ask.** Press ⌘E to open the agent and try: ``` Find a flight from London to Lisbon on Friday under €120 ``` It opens what it needs in a tab group named for the task while you keep browsing. Press ⌘. to take over, and when it's done, one press closes the tabs it opened. **5. Use it from your other agents.** Kaze finds Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Claude Desktop, Gemini CLI and DeepSeek Harness on your Mac and connects them once through its MCP server. In Claude Code, for example: ``` Read the flights I left open in Kaze and add the cheapest to plan.md ``` Disconnect any of them in Settings › External agents, and it stays disconnected. ## Custom Agent endpoints Kaze's built-in Agent can use a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Open **Settings › Agent › Add custom endpoint…** to configure it. For a local gateway such as Magpie: 1. Start the gateway and confirm that it supports OpenAI Chat Completions with streaming and tool calls (function calling). Kaze calls `{base}/chat/completions`; it does not use the Responses API. 2. Enter a **Name** and the gateway's OpenAI-compatible **Base URL**. For a server exposing `/v1/...` on port 3425, use `http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1`. 3. Leave **API key** empty if the gateway does not require one; otherwise, enter its key. 4. Leave **Models** empty to have Kaze fetch chat models from `{base}/models`, or enter model IDs manually. 5. Select a model that supports tool calling and send a small browser task. To let an external agent control Kaze's signed-in tabs, open **Settings › External agents**. Use one-click **Connect** for a supported client, or copy the **MCP configuration** into another MCP client. Magpie is a model gateway; an agent that uses Magpie for its model connects to Kaze through this external-agent flow. ## Highlights | | | |---|---| | **Its own tabs, never yours** | The agent works in background tabs gathered in a group named for the task. Your tabs stay where you left them. Each tab shows its state: working, needs you, done, or you're driving. | | **It asks before it acts** | Before it pays, sends, deletes or runs anything, a card names the exact thing. Nothing happens until you say so. | | **Your models, your Mac** | It runs on the model you choose. Activity, history and settings stay on your Mac. | | **It learns your sites** | What the agent works out on a site is kept as that site's skill and given to it next time. You can read, edit or delete it in Skills. | | **More than one thing at a time** | Subagents split a big task into parallel parts. Scheduled tasks run every morning at 8 or once on Friday. Activity remembers what you read, so "that tram article from last week" finds it. | | **A browser first** | Tabs that tidy themselves, idle tabs that sleep, a ⌘K palette, ⌥E side-by-side translation, built-in ad blocking, Chrome extensions, one colour per window, English and 简体中文. | ## In this repository | | | |---|---| | [Releases](https://github.com/jackwener/Kaze/releases) | Kaze's builds and release notes | | [`skills/`](skills) | The skills Kaze ships with, in the Agent Skills format | | [`Website/`](Website) | The homepage, [kaze.build](https://kaze.build) (static files, deployed with `npx wrangler deploy`) | Kaze's browser tools come from [BrowserMCP](https://github.com/jackwener/BrowserMCP) (Apache-2.0), an open-source MCP server for driving a signed-in browser with a JavaScript workspace and reusable site adapters. It is the engine Kaze lends to your other agents, and it also works on its own with Chrome. ## Feedback Bugs and ideas go in [Issues](https://github.com/jackwener/Kaze/issues). Please include Kaze's version (Kaze › About Kaze) and your Mac's chip.

# Kaze's skills

The skills Kaze ships with. Each is a folder with a `SKILL.md` in the
[Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) format (a name and description in frontmatter, then the
instructions). Kaze puts them in your Skills on first launch, where you can edit them; an edited
one is never overwritten.

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`web-to-markdown`](web-to-markdown/SKILL.md) | Saves a web page as a clean Markdown file |

They're written for Kaze's agent: they read pages through [BrowserMCP](https://github.com/jackwener/BrowserMCP)
(`tab.read()`) and write with Kaze's `save_file`. Another agent with BrowserMCP can use them with
its own way of writing files.

The source of truth is Kaze's own repository; this folder is updated with each release.
